items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was it made by somebody like Conn or somebody like that?

ctx.x: Well, the one I had that I used longer than anything was... Well, what was it? I don't know. I used it about forty years, and I can't even think of the name of it! I don't know.
Was it made by somebody like Conn or somebody like that?
